principles: Send Gmail START and persist provider message_id before substantive work.
Target about 23 minutes of useful project work inside a 25-minute wall-clock tranche.
Reserve the final ~2 minutes for normal closeout; stop optional mutations when close reserve begins.
Primary assistant owns and performs normal Gmail END delivery; automations are not the normal communication mechanism.
The ChatGPT visible thinking-duration indicator is not authoritative for total work and is never used as delivery proof.
Persist CLOSE_INTENT before END, search Gmail by delivery_key, send exactly once if missing, verify SENT/provider message_id, persist CLOSED, then reply in ChatGPT.
Load and enforce the full A+B+C product specification before substantive product mutations.
limitations: This policy guides BCP/project work; it cannot retroactively rewrite past ChatGPT conversations.
ChatGPT itself does not continue executing after a response unless invoked again; resident BCP components may continue independently where implemented.

measurement_truth.chatgpt_thinking_indicator: NOT_AUTHORITATIVE; MAY_BE MUCH SHORTER_THAN TOTAL_TOOL_ORCHESTRATION; NEVER_USED_AS_WORK_PROOF
